topic: 3 companies every AI tool depends on
angle: Your AI bill is set by three companies almost no consumer has heard of.
hook: 3 companies quietly running the AI economy — and why they set your ChatGPT bill
caption:
Every AI tool you use runs on a chip stack owned by a handful of companies. When one of them raises prices, your ChatGPT bill goes up two months later. Understanding this shortens the surprise. This is not a stock tip — it is context that makes tech news readable. Which of these three did you already know?

items.title: TSMC
items.desc: Makes ~90% of advanced AI chips. Taiwan. Bottleneck for everyone.

items.title: ASML
items.desc: Makes the machines TSMC uses. One company. Dutch. Zero competitors.

items.title: NVIDIA
items.desc: Designs the chips TSMC makes. Sets the price the AI world pays.

slides.caption: made in one factory in Taiwan — the entire AI economy passes through it

slides.title: Watch NVIDIA earnings
slides.body: Every 90 days NVIDIA reports. That number tells you if your AI bills go up or down over the next two quarters. Free signal, if you know to look.

slides.text: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google — all three depend on TSMC. When Taiwan sneezes, every AI tool catches a cold two quarters later.
Save this. Next time an AI tool raises prices, you will know why 2 months before the reels do.
